reasoning_steps: Note that the midpoints of the sides of the hexagon form another hexagon.
Understand that the smaller hexagon is similar to the original hexagon.
Recall that the ratio of the side lengths of the smaller hexagon to the original hexagon is 1/2.
Conclude that the area of the smaller hexagon is 1/4 of the area of the original hexagon.
Therefore, the fraction of the area of the original hexagon that is enclosed by the smaller hexagon is 1/4.
